title: AI Meeting Prep Assistant
summary: Before each client meeting, generate a one-page brief with relationship history, open items, and suggested talking points.
businessProblem: Owners and salespeople walk into meetings without refreshing context. They forget prior commitments, repeat questions the client already answered, and miss upsell opportunities visible in past interactions.
outcome: 30 minutes before each meeting, receive a brief: who you're meeting, last 3 interactions summary, open quotes/invoices, and 3 suggested discussion topics.
whoItsFor: Consultants, agency owners, and B2B salespeople with 3–8 client meetings per week who prepare inconsistently.
aiInputs: Upcoming calendar event with attendee names and companies
Last 5 email threads with each attendee
CRM deal stage, notes, and open tasks
Recent call transcripts or meeting notes if available
aiOutputs: Relationship timeline: last contact, deal status, open items
Suggested talking points based on deal stage and history
Warning flags: overdue deliverables, unresolved complaints
noCodeTools: ChatGPT with calendar and email context (manual per meeting)
lowCodeTools: n8n: calendar event 30 min before → Gmail + CRM pull → OpenAI → email brief
Zapier scheduled workflow per calendar event
customBuildStack: Google Calendar API polling for upcoming events
Gmail API for thread search by attendee email
Delivery via email or Slack DM
implementationSteps: Connect calendar, email, and CRM APIs
Define brief template: attendee info, history, open items, talking points
Set trigger: 30 minutes before each external meeting
Filter: only meetings with external attendees (skip internal standups)
Review first 10 briefs for accuracy and tune data sources
Add call transcript integration if available
systemBehavior: Triggered 30 minutes before each qualifying calendar event
Skips internal meetings and events without external attendees
Pulls freshest CRM and email data at generation time
Brief delivered to meeting owner's email or Slack
Does not share brief with meeting attendees automatically
risks: Email search may pull wrong threads if attendee has common name
CRM data staleness produces outdated briefs that mislead
Briefs containing deal values or complaints sent to insecure channels
Over-reliance on briefs reduces genuine relationship memory
